name: sphexi
description: Agents, skills, output styles and curated third-party plugins for Claude Code, installable à la carte.

plugins.name: sphexi-core
plugins.description: Thirteen specialist subagents; the systematic-debugging, code-comments, test-discipline and skill-creator skills; three terseness output styles; and a session-start hook that applies the comment and test standards and the Terse (Full) default.

plugins.name: sphexi-review
plugins.description: Code review, refactoring, testing and debugging: multi-perspective review, PR review agents, feature-dev workflow, TDD cycle, unit testing and accessibility audits.

plugins.name: sphexi-security
plugins.description: Security review: SAST, threat modelling, compliance checks, API and frontend hardening, dependency audits.

plugins.name: sphexi-python
plugins.description: Modern Python: python-pro, FastAPI and Django agents plus Python pattern skills.

plugins.name: sphexi-languages
plugins.description: Bash and POSIX shell, Go, and general developer skills (git, error handling, auth, SQL, e2e testing).

plugins.name: sphexi-backend
plugins.description: Backend architecture, API scaffolding, database design and migrations, and full-stack feature orchestration.

plugins.name: sphexi-infra
plugins.description: Cloud architecture, Kubernetes, Terraform, service mesh and CI/CD pipelines.

plugins.name: sphexi-ai
plugins.description: LLM application development: RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering and LLM evaluation.

plugins.name: twingate-assistant
plugins.description: Twingate zero trust network access: architecture, deployment, infrastructure as code and troubleshooting. Maintained in its own repository, whose reference docs are synced against Twingate's live documentation.
